title: Time-of-flight force sensing below the quantum zero-point fluctuation
summary: Sensing weak forces through observing a mechanical motion near or below its quantum zero-point fluctuation has been desired in diverse areas. While mechanical oscillators have played a crucial role in such studies, their application to free-fall-type sensing has been elusive, in particular in the quantum regime. Here, we demonstrate sensing a static force of the order of 10 zeptonewtons with a levitated nanomechanical oscillator below the zero-point fluctuation through the rapid modulation of its confining potential.
